newsitem.title: UK: United News reports post-merger progress.
newsitem.headline: United News reports post-merger progress.

text.p: British television and newspaper group United News & Media said on Thursday it had made "significant progress" following its merger with diversified UK media group MAI.

It said one-off costs from the merger, completed in April, to date totalled 56.4 million pounds ($87.71 million). Pre-tax profit before exceptional items from the enlarged group totalled 151.9 million pounds in the six months to June 30, a rise of over 20 percent.
